signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: we also reserve the right to terminate your account at any time by written notice due to business reasons which shall include discontinuation of the Services.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: AI credits are consumed whenever you use an AI feature — drafting a cold email, generating a full sequence, rewriting or translating copy, or letting the AI Reply Agent categorize and draft responses.
Each plan includes a monthly allowance, and you can top up with an add-on at any time.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 3 reviews (0.6% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: They have never replied to my email.
I sent a request to Salesblink support and have not received a response yet.
they even "forget" to reply for days.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 4.6/5 vs 4.41/5 all-time (+0.19). 12% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Not checked: domain records were unavailable.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $79 vs a stated $600 regular price (87% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: Any enhancements, new features, or updates (“Updates”) to the Service(s) are also subject to these Terms and we reserve the right to deploy updates at any time.
we may amend these terms from time to time, in which case the new terms will supersede prior versions.

quote.text: Unless otherwise specified in these terms or in a relevant order form, all subscription charges are non-refundable.

finePrint.summary: No refunds are given for partial use or non-use of the service.

quote.text: No refunds shall be issued for partial use or non-use of the Service(s).

finePrint.summary: Vendor can amend the terms at any time with 10 days notice and continued use counts as acceptance.

quote.text: we may amend these terms from time to time, in which case the new terms will supersede prior versions.

finePrint.summary: Vendor reserves the right to deploy updates, enhancements or new features to the service at any time.

quote.text: Any enhancements, new features, or updates (“Updates”) to the Service(s) are also subject to these Terms and we reserve the right to deploy updates at any time.

finePrint.summary: Vendor may suspend access for terms violations and terminate if not cured within 15 days.

quote.text: we may suspend your access to and use of your account or the Service(s) if you are in violation of these terms.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime plans bought from unauthorized sources can be suspended or terminated at any time without notice or liability.

quote.text: If you have purchased a Lifetime Plan from any source other than us or our expressly authorized channels, such plan is unauthorized, and we reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access and account at any point of time, without notice and without being liable to you.

quote.text: If you have purchased a lifetime plan or lifetime deal of the Service(s) from any source (a “Lifetime Plan”), you may manage your clients using the Service(s)

finePrint.summary: AI features consume credits and each plan includes only a monthly allowance requiring top-ups for more use.

quote.text: AI credits are consumed whenever you use an AI feature — drafting a cold email, generating a full sequence, rewriting or translating copy, or letting the AI Reply Agent categorize and draft responses.

quote.text: Each plan includes a monthly allowance, and you can top up with an add-on at any time.

trials.claim: Gradually increases sending limits to keep campaign on track
trials.claimQuote: And because sending bulk emails all at once can get your account blocked, this feature gradually increases your sending limits to keep your campaign on track.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report being told not to use slow ramp and scheduled campaigns failing to send at all, which materially undercuts the promise that gradual limits keep campaigns on track despite the vendor listing the ramp feature.

exhibits.quote: email volume not sending as they should have been and was buggy for no reason (I was told not to use slow ramp and to disable bounce protect which is pointless because I wanted to utilise those features)
exhibits.argument: Buyer was told not to use ramp-up and bounce protection, undermining the claim that gradual limits keep campaigns on track.

exhibits.quote: there are times when a campaign is scheduled to send emails, but when the scheduled time comes, the campaign doesn’t send the emails at all.
exhibits.argument: Scheduled campaigns fail to send at all, contradicting the promise to keep campaigns on track.

exhibits.quote: Our automated warmup system gradually builds your sender reputation through smart interactions with real inboxes, ensuring your cold emails consistently land in the primary inbox—not the spam folder.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states its system gradually builds sender reputation to keep cold emails landing in primary inbox.

exhibits.quote: Sequence Sending Ramp Up Grow each sender's daily send volume gradually Daily Sending Limit per Sender Cap how many cold emails each mailbox sends a day
exhibits.argument: The vendor lists a ramp-up feature that grows each sender's daily send volume gradually.

trials.claim: Previous Plus customers can buy more codes to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo Plus customers who purchased SalesBlink can buy more codes to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: A buyer purchased 8 codes that were never applied to the account, directly conflicting with the claim that buying more codes increases feature limits; the defense exhibits only show planning or buying a second code, not limits increasing.

exhibits.quote: I purchased 8 codes that I have yet to be applied to my account.
exhibits.argument: Buying more codes did not increase limits because codes were never applied despite support request.

exhibits.quote: I initially bought one code, planning to add another later if the platform worked well for me.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms planning to add another code after the first purchase.

exhibits.quote: A few days later, I bought a second code through the upsell on their website because the deal looked good at $59 instead of $79.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms successfully buying a second code to stack on the account.

trials.claim: Includes all future Growth or Business Plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Growth (Tier 1-3) or Business (Tier 4-10) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: No exhibit shows whether future Growth or Business plan updates are actually included for deal buyers; reports of no updates and generic terms about deploying updates do not prove or disprove inclusion.

exhibits.quote: I've owned this tool since last year, and I see no updates, changes, new features, or fixes. It seems like just a money grab.
exhibits.argument: Long-term owner reports receiving no updates or new features, undermining promise of all future updates.

exhibits.quote: we also reserve the right to terminate your account at any time by written notice due to business reasons which shall include discontinuation of the Services.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can terminate access for business reasons, voiding any guarantee of future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: Any enhancements, new features, or updates (“Updates”) to the Service(s) are also subject to these Terms and we reserve the right to deploy updates at any time.
exhibits.argument: The terms confirm enhancements, new features and updates are part of the service.

trials.claim: Sends personalized cold emails generated with AI that land in inbox every time
trials.claimQuote: Send personalized cold emails generated with AI that land in your lead’s inbox, every time
trials.reasoning: Multiple buyers report emails never reaching inboxes or inbox problems after setup, directly contradicting the absolute claim of landing in the inbox every time.

exhibits.quote: None of the emails I sent even reached customers’ inboxes.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports zero inbox delivery, directly contradicting inbox every time claim.

exhibits.quote: I setup my Salesblink account, and suddenly I'm having issues with my emails reaching inboxes.
exhibits.argument: Using SalesBlink caused inbox failures even for staff emails, contradicting guaranteed inbox delivery.

exhibits.quote: Launch personalized sequences that land in inboxes, get replies and book meetings.
exhibits.argument: The vendor promises personalized sequences that land in inboxes.

exhibits.quote: keeping messages out of spam filters and landing right in primary inboxes.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms messages land right in primary inboxes out of spam.

trials.claim: AI-powered tool generates and sends cold emails that land directly in inbox
trials.claimQuote: SalesBlink is an AI-powered outreach tool that lets you generate and send cold emails that land directly in your lead’s inbox.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report every test email going to spam and most emails bouncing, outweighing one positive review and contradicting direct inbox delivery.

exhibits.quote: Started a basic campaign to test and every email is going to spam.
exhibits.argument: Test campaign landed entirely in spam, contradicting claim of landing directly in inbox.

exhibits.quote: Most emails you send bounce; this tool simply doesn’t work.
exhibits.argument: Most sends bounce rather than inbox, undermining AI inbox delivery claim.

exhibits.quote: Every plan ships with AI sequences, unlimited email accounts, unlimited WarmUp, AI credits and MCP for AI agents — so your agent can run outreach from day one.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states every plan ships with AI sequences to run outreach.

exhibits.quote: The multi-channel outreach options and warm-up features ensure that our emails actually land in the inbox rather than the spam folder.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms emails actually land in the inbox rather than spam.

trials.claim: BlinkGPT AI launches cold emails in minutes
trials.claimQuote: BlinkGPT AI makes it easy to launch cold emails in minutes, offloading the worst of your cold email outreach tasks.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the tool sent no email for over two months and remained unusable for production for months, contradicting the promise to launch cold emails in minutes despite one report of fast sequence generation.

exhibits.quote: For over 2 months this tool has not sent 1 email... back and forth with support and still nothing.
exhibits.argument: Tool sent nothing for months despite support, contradicting launch in minutes claim.

exhibits.quote: Since May, we've been waiting for this app to reach a stable, production-ready state, but unfortunately, it’s still not usable for production purposes.
exhibits.argument: App was still not usable for production after months, undermining quick-launch promise.

exhibits.quote: Instead of spending hours writing copy and pacing follow-ups, I input a quick summary of my offer and audience, and the AI generates a multi-step sequence in minutes.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms BlinkGPT generates a multi-step sequence in minutes.

exhibits.quote: Simply describe your business and target audience—Outreach AI instantly creates personalized multi-step sequences with compelling follow-ups.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states describing business lets AI instantly create personalized sequences.

after using the warm up feature, found my deliverability score sucks.

hits.quote: It feels very outdated and unpleasant to use.
the UI is pretty bad and the flow is hard to follow.

hits.quote: It has significantly streamlined our cold email outreach and automated our follow-ups
The automated email warm-up and smart sender rotation protect domain health

hits.quote: SalesBlink consolidated everything into one clean platform on a lifetime license.
Many of the monthly paid cold email software charge higher/month for the features

hits.quote: The $4/month per email is the only thing that bugs me a bit
